name: esphome
description: ESPHome is a system to control your ESP8266/ESP32 by simple yet powerful configuration files and control them remotely through Home Automation systems.

variables.name: ESPHOME_DASHBOARD_USE_PING
variables.description: Use ping rather than mDNS to get device status, set to true if devices are appearing offline

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: UID for permissions. Do not change unless you know what you're doing.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: GID for permissions. Do not change unless you know what you're doing.

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: UMASK for newly created files. Do not change unless you know what you're doing.
